blocks.orig: Fundu Lagoon is a boutique hotel on Pemba Island and a little paradise in itself. Located on the beach against a hill, it has beautiful tented rooms with thatched roofs on the beach, as well as a bit higher on the hill. The suites have beautiful little plunge pools on their terrace, besides there being a main pool near the restaurant. Fundu Lagoon is a great place for those who want to go diving or snorkelling, but also for those who just need a place to let go of all of their worldly worries…!
blocks.html: On Pemba Island, Fundu Lagoon is a boutique hotel that is a small paradise of its own. Set on the beach against a hillside, it has lovely tented rooms with thatched roofs right on the sand, as well as a little higher up the hill. The suites come with pretty little plunge pools on the terrace, and there is also a main pool close to the restaurant. Fundu Lagoon suits anyone keen on diving or snorkelling, as well as anyone who simply needs somewhere to leave all their everyday worries behind…!
